### The Co-Op Profession & Craftable BiS Brain for WoW Forever

  **Stop vendoring mats your friends are about to buy. Stop alt-tabbing for static guides.**

  ComradeCraft connects your alts, friends, and guild into one live crafting economy. **100% in-game, zero spreadsheets, zero external servers** (and works standalone solo too).

  [![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-Download-d4a017?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=7a1414)](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/comradecraft)
  ![WoW Forever 1.60.1](https://img.shields.io/badge/WoW%20Forever-1.60.1-d4a017?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=7a1414)
  ![7 Languages](https://img.shields.io/badge/Languages-7-d4a017?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=7a1414)
  ![License MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-d4a017?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=7a1414)

---

## Why ComradeCraft?

Static guides don't know what's in your bags. Economy addons don't coordinate your friends. **ComradeCraft bridges both**: every route, bag highlight, tooltip, bank withdraw, and mail attachment thinks across your entire group.

| The Problem | How ComradeCraft Fixes It |
|---|---|
| You AH or vendor Silk Cloth, and your friend buys it an hour later | **Bag highlights, Keep alerts & 1-click Mail / Trade / Bank helpers** |
| Static guides waste gold ignoring mats already in your group | **Live Cheapest / Profitable routes** using group stock + live AH prices |
| Alt-tabbing for Expert/Artisan trainers, drops, or craftable BiS | **All 12 Expert/Artisan trainers (Alliance & Horde) + Standalone BiS Engine (9 classes, 29 specs)** |
| Friends play at different hours or switch alts constantly | **100% in-game Mesh Sync + Guild Channel Sync + Shared Bank Alts** |
| Juggling Lesser & Greater enchanting essences by hand | **Automatic 3x Lesser <-> 1x Greater conversion** across plans, mail & bags |

  ![ComradeCraft Plan Window: Live Cheapest vs Profitable Routes (+44s 92c), Quality Borders & Collapsible Group Sidebar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JF10R/comradeCraft/master/docs/images/plan-window.jpg)

---

## Key Features

### 1. Dynamic Leveling & Economy
- **Cheapest vs Profitable routes**: Live cost per 75-point milestone, factoring vendor sell, disenchant value, and AH resale (after 5% cut & deposit risk).
- **Zero-waste Essence Conversions**: Automatic `3x Lesser <-> 1x Greater` math across plans, surplus, mail, bags, and right-click conversion hints.
- **All 12 Expert (150 to 225) & Artisan (225 to 300) Trainers**: Built-in Alliance & Horde trainers, rank-unlock books (Cooking, First Aid, Fishing), and Artisan quests with QuestieDB + TomTom waypoints.
- **1-Click Shopping Export**: Instant Auctionator shopping lists or copy-ready TSM exact search strings & groups.

  ![1-Click TSM Shopping Search & Group Import](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JF10R/comradeCraft/master/docs/images/tsm-shopping.png)

### 2. Co-Op Group Brain & Shared Bank Alts
- **Mesh Sync & Guild Channel Sync**: Mutually added peers automatically relay up-to-date snapshots for offline friends, keeping everyone synced across timezones with zero external apps.
- **Shared Bank Alts**: Flag any alt as a *Shared bank alt* so 100% of its bags, bank, and mail appear as available group stock, searchable with **1-click item requests**.
- **Item Reservations (`Alt+Right-Click`)**: Lock and tag bag items for a specific friend with a violet lock badge, anti-sell warning, 1-click Bank & Mail queuing, and live sync so they see `"Reserved for you"` before you even hit Send.
- **Bag Highlights, Auto-Sort Categories & Tooltips**: Crisp borders & mailbox badges light up spare mats, reserved items, unknown non-BoP patterns, and request reagents in your bags, focusing in gold on your active Mail or Trade target, plus native **`ComradeCraft` categories** in Baganator and BetterBags.
- **Craft Requests, Shared Wishlist & Farming Banner**: Request crafts or bank items, pin shared goals in an on-screen tracker, see a live **"Farming for you"** banner on `Group -> Overview`, and share missing mats to `/g` or `/p` in 1 click.
- **Favorites, Guild Directory & 100+ Guild Scaling**: Star favorite players and preferred crafters to pin them at the top of the Sidebar & Guild Directory (and prioritize them in `Upgrades`), quick-filter large rosters, search `/comrade directory`, and get live dungeon loot roll hints.

  ![ComradeCraft Tour: Group Overview, Materials, Can Craft & Patterns to Hunt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JF10R/comradeCraft/master/docs/images/tour-overview.gif)

  ![Alt+Right-Click Item Reservations & Clean Group Tooltip Demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JF10R/comradeCraft/master/docs/images/reserve-demo.gif)

  ![Mail Helper Live Demo: Select Friend, 1-Click Attach & Send](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JF10R/comradeCraft/master/docs/images/mail-demo.gif)

### 3. Standalone Craftable BiS Engine & Patterns to Hunt (9 Classes, 29 Specs)
- **Auto-detects specs** from talents & spells (with 1-click UI / `/comrade spec` override), with zero external addon required.
- **Top 5 craftable upgrades per slot** across yourself (incl. BoP), alts, friends, and guild directory, with 2H vs 1H+OH math, wands, 180+ combat enchants, `+1-4 lvl` upcoming BiS, and spec consumables.
- **Dedicated `Patterns` Tab**: Lists high-value unlearned gear, enchanting formulas, bigger bags, and consumables for yourself and your group, complete with **where to buy or farm, drop rates (358 Classic recipes + optional Forever Drops/Lootified connector), BoE AH prices, 1-click TomTom waypoints**, and **1-click BoE pattern AH search**.

  ![Patterns to Hunt: Drop Rates, AH Prices & 1-Click Waypoints](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JF10R/comradeCraft/master/docs/images/patterns-tab.jpg)

### 4. Companion Panels Everywhere You Click
- **Mailbox** (Blizzard, Postbox, Postal, ElvUI, TSM): 1-click attach for mats, patterns & requests, bank-only warnings, and WoW Forever First+Last name safety.
- **Bank**: 1-click **Withdraw needed** for your current step, Wishlist, or queued group mail.
- **Merchant**: Highlights plan reagents and learnable rank books/recipes **directly in Blizzard's vendor window**, plus a side panel to buy exact missing quantities or buried Page 3 books (like *Expert Cookbook* for a friend) in 1 click.
- **Auction House**: 1-click search for missing mats and **BoE BiS patterns** with gold balance summary.
- **Trainer & Trade**: Trainer BiS/plan highlighter and 1-click trade fill.
- **Craft Queue**: Docked step panel beside your profession window with a **Craft next** button.

  ![Merchant Native Slot Highlights & 1-Click Page 3 Rank Books](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JF10R/comradeCraft/master/docs/images/merchant-demo.gif)

  ![Docked Step Panel & Craft Queue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JF10R/comradeCraft/master/docs/images/step-panel.png)

---

## Get Started in 30 Seconds

1. Click the **ComradeCraft minimap button** (or type `/comrade`).
2. Open **Manage group**, check characters to share (and optionally flag a **Shared bank alt**).
3. Add friends by name or click **Add** on guildmates/party members. *(Playing solo? Every route, BiS audit, shopping list, and companion panel works out of the box.)*

---

## Compatible & Recommended Addons

**Zero dependencies required**: ComradeCraft works 100% standalone with Blizzard's default UI and bundles every needed library. Installing any of the addons below unlocks extra integrations automatically:

| Category | Compatible / Complementary Addons | Integration |
|---|---|---|
| **Economy & AH** *(Recommended)* | **TradeSkillMaster (TSM)**, **Auctionator** | Live AH prices, disenchant values, 1-click Auctionator shopping lists, copy-ready TSM exact search & group imports, and 1-click BoE BiS pattern search |
| **Bags & Bank** | **Blizzard Bags**, **Bagnon**, **BagBrother**, **Combuctor**, **Baganator**, **BetterBags**, **ElvUI**, **EllesmereUI**, **ArkInventory** | Native in-bag borders, violet lock & mailbox badges, Mail/Trade focus dimming, `Alt+Right-Click` item reservations, Bank quick-withdraw docking, plus native **`ComradeCraft` auto-sort category** in **Baganator** & **BetterBags** |
| **Mailbox** | **Blizzard Mail**, **Postbox**, **Postal**, **ElvUI**, **TSM Mailing** | Seamless mailbox side-panel docking, live recipient focus, 1-click attach, and WoW Forever `"First Last"` name resolution (`Postbox` recipient history supported) |
| **Map, Waypoints & Drops** | **TomTom**, **Questie**, **Forever Drops**, **Lootified** | 1-click TomTom map arrows, exact Questie NPC/vendor/mob coordinates (with built-in fallback coords for all 34 Expert/Artisan trainers), and optional live server drop rates on top of the built-in 358 Classic recipe drop table |
| **Gear & DataText Bars** | **Pawn**, **Titan Panel**, **Bazooka**, **ChocolateBar**, **ElvUI DataTexts** | Optional custom Pawn stat-weight fallback (fast standalone 9-class / 29-spec BiS engine built in) and live LibDataBroker counter + Blizzard Addon Compartment support |

---

## Privacy, Performance & Languages

- **Privacy-First**: Nothing leaves your client until you opt in. Full records go only by addon whisper to mutually added friends; Guild Directory shares only professions & recipes.
- **Built for Zero Lag**: Fast C-API stat scoring, combat-deferred refreshes (`PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED`), diffed bag scans, and per-frame overlay caching.
- **Native WoW Integration**: Blizzard Options panel (`Esc -> Options -> AddOns`), customizable UI scale & resizable height, native Keybinding (`Bindings.xml`), Addon Compartment + LibDataBroker DataText (TitanPanel/Bazooka/ElvUI), rarity borders, and subtle sound notifications.
- **Native WoW Forever 1.60.1**: Full two-part `"First Last"` name support with auto-migration and active live recipe difficulty calibration.
- **7 Languages**: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, and Russian.

**Chat Commands** (every action also has a UI button)

| Command | Action |
|---|---|
| `/comrade` | Open the ComradeCraft window |
| `/comrade spec [name]` | View or override your character's BiS spec |
| `/comrade shop [profession]` | Export missing mats to Auctionator or TSM |
| `/comrade tracker [reset]` | Toggle or re-dock the step panel |
| `/comrade mail NAME` | Prepare mail attachments for a group member |
| `/comrade reserve [ITEM] NAME [QTY]` | Lock/reserve a bag item for a friend (or `Alt+Right-Click` in bags) |
| `/comrade share [on\|off\|all\|none]` | Toggle character sharing |
| `/comrade list [off]` / `directory [text]` | Opt into or search the guild crafter directory |
| `/comrade add NAME` / `remove NAME` | Add or remove a player |
| `/comrade peers` / `sync` | View peers or force a sync now |
| `/comrade needs` / `stats` / `audit` | Print leveling route, calibration, or BiS audit |

---

## For Developers & Feedback

- Built & actively maintained for **WoW Forever 1.60.1** (Interface `16001`). Bug reports & ideas welcome in [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/JF10R/comradeCraft/issues).
- Offline verification suite: `python tools/check_lua.py` (syntax, 6-locale parity, 18 unit test suites).
- License: **MIT** ([LICENSE](https://github.com/JF10R/comradeCraft/blob/master/LICENSE), embedded libraries in [THIRD_PARTY.md](https://github.com/JF10R/comradeCraft/blob/master/THIRD_PARTY.md)).

# ComradeCraft

## v0.3.0

### Highlights
- **Built-In Craftable BiS Engine & `Patterns` Tab (All 9 Classes, 29 Specs)**: Auto-detects your spec and shows the best craftable gear, enchants, wands, consumables, and upcoming `+1-4 lvl` upgrades across yourself, your alts, your friends, and your guild. A new **`Patterns`** tab on every character sheet lists valuable unlearned gear, enchant formulas, bags, and consumables to buy or farm (with drop rates for 358 Classic recipes, BoE AH prices, and 1-click TomTom waypoints).
- **Shared Bank Alts & Item Requests**: Flag any alt as a **Shared bank alt** so its entire stock (bags, bank, mail) shows as available to your group, and friends can request items directly through the addon.
- **Reserve Items for Friends (`Alt+Right-Click`)**: Lock any item in your bags for a specific friend. Shows a violet lock badge, warns before vendoring/AHing, queues automatically in Bank/Mail/Trade, and shows up in their **Reserved for you** banner before you even send it.
- **Sync Across Timezones (100% In-Game)**: Friends automatically relay updates for offline group members (Mesh Sync) and guild alt-switches sync right away, with zero external apps or servers.
- **Smart Craft Requests**: Glowing sidebar indicator for incoming requests, live material/stock progress visible to both players (`Missing X`, `Ready to craft`, `Ready to ship`), and automatic tracking (`Crafting` when you cast it, `Shipped` when you mail or trade it).
- **Bank, Merchant & Trainer Companion Panels**: 1-click **Withdraw needed** beside your Bank, native vendor slot highlights + 1-click buying (even for Page 3 books like *Expert Cookbook* for a friend), and a Trainer panel highlighting leveling-plan and group-BiS recipes ready to learn.
- **All 12 Expert & Artisan Trainers (Alliance & Horde)**: Built-in trainer, book (Cooking, First Aid, Fishing), and quest guide with Questie locations and 1-click TomTom waypoints (with built-in fallback coordinates for all 34 NPCs).

### Quality of Life & UI Polish
- **Automatic Enchanting Essence Conversions**: Seamlessly handles `3x Lesser <-> 1x Greater` essences across plans, bags, mail, trade, and tooltips, with right-click conversion hints.
- **Native Bag Sorter Categories**: Adds a built-in `ComradeCraft` category for **Baganator** and **BetterBags** so group and reserved items stay grouped together.
- **Built for Large Guilds (100+ Characters)**: Star favorite players/crafters, collapse Sidebar sections (`Favorites`, `My characters`, `Group members`), quick-filter large rosters, and see a live **Farming for you** banner.
- **Cleaner Tables & Visual Polish**: Alternating row shading and green self-craft highlights in `Upgrades` (with 1-click `Request`), item rarity borders on icons, clickable Bank Alt stock cards in `Materials`, 1-click **BoE pattern AH search**, 1-click `/g` or `/p` chat sharing, subtle sound alerts, and consistent `X` close buttons on all side panels.
- **Native Blizzard Options & System Integration**: New `Esc -> Options -> AddOns -> ComradeCraft` settings page (UI scale `75%-125%`, per-panel toggles, minimap/sound toggles, 1-click reset positions), resizable window height, native Keybinding support, Addon Compartment, and TitanPanel/Bazooka/ElvUI DataText badges.

### Key Bug Fixes
- Fixed tooltips and bags sometimes suggesting to mail materials to yourself on WoW Forever two-part names (`First Last`).
- Fixed the Mail helper panel staying open after closing **Postbox**.
- Fixed Expert book vendor faction matching for Horde First Aid (`Balai Lok'Wein`) and Alliance Cooking (`Shandrina`).
- Fixed 2H weapon and Shield enchant recommendations matching the wrong weapon slots.
- Fixed **Bagnon** cached-alt bag windows showing highlights for your active character.

### Details & Technical Notes
- **Performance**: Instant window opens using C-API `C_Item.GetItemStats` before Pawn tooltip scraping, 60-100x faster Bagnon/BagBrother slot highlights via per-frame caching, diffed event scans, debounced search, and combat-deferred refreshes (`PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED`).
- **WoW Forever 1.60.1**: Full `"First Last"` name safety across mail/trade/sync, automatic migration of legacy 1-word alt keys via Guild Roster and Friends List, and active live calibration of Forever recipe difficulty bounds.
- **Addons & Compatibility**: Tested with Postbox, Postal, TSM Mailing, TradeSkillMaster, Auctionator, Bagnon, BagBrother, Combuctor, Baganator, BetterBags, ElvUI, EllesmereUI, ArkInventory, Questie, TomTom, and Pawn. Mail and Trade panels clearly separate bag-ready items from bank-only items (`in bank`).
- **Architecture**: Split monolithic `UI.lua` into `UI/{Widgets,Plan,Group,Social,Window}.lua` and `Needs.lua` into `Pricing.lua`, `Needs.lua`, and `GroupNeeds.lua`, plus new `Bank.lua`, `Reserve.lua`, `Options.lua`, and `Bindings.xml` (67 Lua files, 7 languages, 19 automated test suites).

## v0.2.0

- Guild directory (opt-in, per character): list a character in Manage group or with
  `/comrade list`; guildmates with the addon search who can craft an item
  (`/comrade directory`), whisper them, and see up to 3 guild crafters in item tooltips.
- Group plan: plans count stock already in the group as free (or market value, in Options),
  a view of what the group still needs and its cost, and opt-in farming assignments with a tracker.
- Keep for the group: at a merchant or the AH, the bag items your group needs; Buy back
  after selling one.
- Auction values count the 5% cut and the deposit risk (refunded on sale on Forever).
- Shared craft wishlist: pin any recipe for yourself or a friend, track materials in a movable
  on-screen tracker, get an alert when ready to craft, and sync pinned items with your group.
- Bag highlights: badges and glows on items your group needs in Blizzard bags, Baganator,
  Bagnon, Combuctor and ElvUI, dynamically focused on the active mailbox or trade recipient.
- Side panels at the Mailbox, Trade window, Merchant (1-click reagent auto-buy), and Auction
  House (1-click search for missing materials with gold balance summary).
- Cross-profession synergies (Craft -> Disenchant and Raw -> Intermediate), Group Upgrades
  audit (small bags, missing enchants, craftable upgrades), and gold-aware Buy vs Farm advice
  with QuestieDB farm spots and TomTom waypoints.
- Recipe-item tooltips and group loot roll hints showing who still needs a recipe or urgent mat.
- UI rework with authentic dark-stone Blizzard styling, organized Group sub-tabs
  (Overview, Materials, Upgrades, Disenchant), Share all / auto-share new characters, and
  right-click player menu integration to add friends to your group.
- Route accuracy and bug fixes: automatic recalculation on learning new recipes (world drops,
  vendors, Forever custom recipes), trainer refusal detection with right-click skip on Learn
  steps, strict BoP/soulbound handling in Disenchant/Keep advice, and duplicate character
  cleanup on multi-word realms.

## v0.1.0

First version for WoW Forever (Interface 16001):

- Group needs window: per character plan (what to craft, what to learn at the trainer, costs
  with TSM or Auctionator), "can craft" list, group overview, profession filters.
- Item tooltip: who in the group needs this material, and how soon.
- Opt-in sharing with friends and guildmates you add (addon messages, no server).
- Step panel next to the profession window: current step, skill-up chance, crafts your bags
  allow, next step (`/comrade tracker`).
- Shopping list: export a plan's missing mats to Auctionator, or copy a TSM search text and
  group import (`/comrade shop`); finished or replaced TSM groups are reported.
- Disenchant advice uses the TSM or Auctionator disenchant value when available.
- Mail helper, disenchant-or-keep advice, gear upgrades (Pawn when installed).
- Route types: Cheapest (default) or Profitable (products sold back), with the cost of both
  per 75-point milestone.
- Help page (? button) and a short first-open tour.
- Where to get a recipe: hover a "Learn" step for its trainers, vendors and drops (with
  Questie positions); click it for a TomTom waypoint to the nearest one.
- Craft queue in the step panel: this step or up to the milestone, what your bags allow now,
  and a Craft next button (one batch per click, as the game requires).
- Collapse professions in Plan and Can craft; Can craft in columns; plan steps and a
  milestone table with net cost (mats minus the best resale).
- Craft requests between group members, kept until the other player's addon confirms it
  received them (both online once is enough).
- Alerts (Manage group > Options): mats ready, cooldowns ready on any character, craft
  requests, and opt-in upgrades a group member can craft (with Pawn score or stats).
- Next rank at the skill cap: Expert book (vendor or AH), Artisan quest from Questie with a
  TomTom waypoint to its giver, or the trainer.
- German, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese and Russian translations.
- Addon logo as the minimap button, window portrait and addon list icon.
- Trainers you visit are remembered and come first in waypoints; distances work across
  zones (HereBeDragons, shipped with TomTom).
